items.requirement: Specify the shared distributional conditions for the upper bounds. Every two-dimensional feature projection must have a density bounded below near the origin and bounded above by a radial envelope with finite zeroth and first moments. The tail cases are bounded features and sub-exponential features.
items.quote: onto an arbitrary two-dimensional subspace V

items.requirement: State the improved logistic-only guarantee under radial Lipschitzness, which controls changes in each projected density with angle at fixed radius. With bounded features and a constant integrated Lipschitz coefficient, the population minimizer achieves O(OPT) zero-one risk. The sub-exponential bound includes a logarithmic factor in OPT and depends on the integrated coefficient.
